source: Figma — final HEYDRU 2021 (Copy), BRANDBOOK page (Color Styles + COLORES frame)
notes: CMYK is only documented in the source for the 4 core colors (Red, Azul, Yellow, Black) — the other 8 exist only as Color Styles, no print breakdown given. Heydru-Black's HEX (#393A3E) is verified against the Color Style and against logo-dark.svg/favicon.svg; the source deck's own RGB text label for it (34,33,33) doesn't match that HEX and appears to be a typo in the original artwork, not a second valid value.

terminology.sintesisGrafica: icon mark alone, no wordmark (commonly called the isotipo)

logo.clearSpace: On all four sides of the marca gráfica, equal to one icon-mark's width/height, measured from the lockup's outer edges — per the source file's own guideline frames.

onDark.use: white wordmark, no icon, for dark backgrounds

onLight.use: Heydru-Black wordmark, no icon, for light backgrounds

typography.source: Roboto only, per the source brandbook's own TIPOGRAFÍA PRINCIPAL frame

liveWebsitePairing.note: heydru.com currently pairs Poppins (headings) with Roboto (body). This pairing was introduced at website-build time and is not part of the original 2021 brandbook — recorded here as the de facto live choice, not as something verified against the source file.
